title.narrative: EMBEROI III - Expansion in Organic agriculture with Indian Ocean Regional Expertise

description.narrative: The action aims to promote a healthy and resilient agriculture through : (i) the establishment of a School Farm to support the increasing of organic production (production of seed, trainings, etc), with the support of an expertise from La Reunion ; (ii) awareness and communication campaigns targeting the producers, the consumers, the leaders, the young people, the tourists.
